principles: Send Gmail START and persist provider message_id before substantive work.

Target approximately 23 minutes of useful work inside a 25-minute wall-clock tranche; return earlier only for a true human gate, tool/safety failure, or a completed atomic action that should not be artificially prolonged.
Reserve the final 2 minutes for PRIMARY_ASSISTANT closeout; do not start optional product mutations after minute 23.
Primary assistant sends and verifies the normal Gmail END directly; scheduled jobs are not required for normal closeout.
Persist CLOSE_INTENT before END, search Gmail by delivery_key, send if missing, persist END_ACKNOWLEDGED/CLOSED, then reply in ChatGPT.
The UI thinking-duration indicator is not controllable proof of wall-clock work; durable commits/tests/readbacks/receipts are the work evidence.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.

measurement_truth.chatgpt_thinking_indicator: NOT_AUTHORITATIVE; MAY_BE MUCH SHORTER_THAN TOTAL_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION; NEVER_USED_AS_WORK_PROOF
